verdict.rationale: Smithery's documented Triggers let an MCP server surface upstream events and POST them to a consumer after the consumer activates a trigger. That is an event-delivery building block, not a user-defined rule engine that runs actions automatically. The proxied trigger path also sat on the Connect services that shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
